chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Hisham ibn Salim and Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari and others, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), in
Allah erases what He wills and confirms what He wills
He (AS) said: He (AS) said: And does Allah erase except that which existed? And does He confirm except that which did not exist?!
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Allah 'erases' or 'confirms' in the Quran?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that 'erasing' (Mahw) denotes the removal of a previously existing reality, while 'confirming' (Ithbat) signifies the bringing into existence of something that was not yet manifest. This interpretation anchors the doctrine of Al-Bada' in the dynamic unfolding of divine decree, distinguishing between the eternal knowledge of Allah and its temporal manifestation in creation. Such exegesis underscores the flexibility of God's will in altering circumstances without implying a change in His essential knowledge.
